ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light grey) spanning approximately 85% of the surface area, contrasted against low-intensity (black) along the trailing edge, lateral tips, and scattered surface nodes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field with a continuous black perimeter band. Numerous small, sub-circular black nodes (2-8 pixels in diameter) are distributed non-uniformly across the white regions. A larger, distinct dark circular spot is located on the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and moderate depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks and valleys (amplitude of 5-15 pixels) are particularly prominent on the inner halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex transition starting from the peduncle, extending into a wide sweep that curves sharply upward at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular and semi-circular dark-ringed marks (barnacle scars) distributed primarily in the central-lower portion of both lobes and concentrated near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) across the ventral surface; distinct dark focal lesion on the bottom-center of the left lobe; visible calcified deposits on the trailing edge of the right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of active white barnacle clusters embedded within the black pigmented surface at the extreme distal end of the right fluke lobe.
